source.label: Banc of California 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 30, 2023, Banc of California, Inc. completed its transformational merger with PacWest Bancorp ("PacWest"), pursuant to which PacWest merged into Banc of California, Inc., (the "Merger") with Banc of California, Inc. continuing as the surviving legal corporation, and, as of December 1, 2023, Banc of California, N.A. merged into Pacific Western Bank, with Pacific Western Bank continuing under the Banc of California name and brand as the Bank.
